label: Bible Study
prompt: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the _____, and giveth grace to the humble.
verse: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
note: Peter quotes Proverbs 3:34 — God resists the proud and favours the humble.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good _____ from a far country.
verse: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
note: Good news from a far country is like cold water to a thirsty soul — every traveler's family knows the feeling.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen _____, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verse: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
note: God's object lesson for Jeremiah: buy a linen girdle, wear it, then bury it by the river until it's ruined.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to _____ them that are tempted.
verse: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
note: Succour means run to help — and he can, because he faced temptation himself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his _____ unto his servants the prophets.
verse: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
note: The herdsman-prophet's assurance: the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing his 'secret' to his servants the prophets.
